# Deep Search

> Small, auditable, keyless metasearch CLI & Agent Skill.

## Agent Skill Installation
Copy `.agents/skills/deep-search/SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory (e.g. `.agents/skills/deep-search/`, `~/.claude/skills/deep-search/`, or `~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_skills/deep-search/`).

## Execution
- Instant execution: `uvx deep-search-agent "<query>" --limit 10`
- CLI package install: `pipx install deep-search-agent`
- Fallback runner: `$(command -v python3 || command -v python) .agents/skills/deep-search/scripts/run.py "<query>"`

## Key Options
- `--limit <n>`: Number of results (default: 10)
- `--site <domain>`: Add domain filter (repeatable up to 5 times)
- `--fetch`: Extract clean, bounded Markdown from the top pages
- `--profile <general|dev|academic>`: Domain ranking profile boosting authoritative sources
- `--mode <plain|exact|oss>`: Search query optimization mode
- `--diagnose`: Probe reachability of search backend hosts

## Output Guarantees
`stdout` is strictly versioned JSON conforming to the deep-search schema contract. All diagnostic logs and warnings are directed to `stderr`.
